_doc: Level-2 orchestrator state for ONE DAG inside a fleet run. Holds a task-DAG (many tasks with internal dependsOn[]), NOT a single slice's progress. Reports to CAPTAIN (status only). Location: <repo>/plans/fleet/<yyyy-mm-dd>-<epic>/dags/<dagId>.json (RELATIVE to project repo root, committed there). A DAG can run for HOURS -> persist every task-step so resume continues mid-DAG. Design ref: pi config docs/design/2026-07-03-fleet-dag-rework.md (§State Schema, Level-2).
_instantiate: Created by the DAG orchestrator on dispatch (copies effective assignment from Level-1). Updated every task-step + every assumption/escalation. Planner defines checkCommand per task (validation lapis-1, executable truth-signal) PLUS a level-DAG integration check placed on the LAST task's edge-gate (covers cross-task integration, per design doc §Validation). CRITICAL: partial work must be COMMITTED to the DAG branch per task (commitSha), not just recorded here.
_escalation_boundary: Technical escalation STOPS at the orchestrator. Only DAG STATUS goes up to captain. Orchestrator resolves ambiguity itself + records in assumptions[].

assignment._doc: DAG-level effective assignment (mirrors Level-1 effective* at dispatch) + upgrade audit trail. Per-task implementer/reviewer live inside tasks[]; this block is the DAG-wide default + safety-ratchet jejak.

tasks._dependsOn_doc: Pure task-level dependency (task-DAG internal). Downstream task blocked until upstream edge-gate passed.
tasks._reviewer_doc: Only used when orchestrator = Sonnet (separate reviewer per task). When orchestrator = Opus, orchestrator RANGKAP/doubles-as reviewer inline; this field then advisory.
tasks._edgeGateStatus_doc: downstream node blocked until upstream review passed.
tasks._commitSha_doc: null initially. Partial work committed to branch per task -> resume = checkout branch@commitSha + continue.
tasks._artifactPointer_doc: null initially. Pointer to task artifact (state/commit/output).
tasks._reviewVerdict_doc: null initially. Review pass REQUIRES acceptanceResult=pass (green executable), NOT just reading code.
tasks._checkCommand_doc: Executable truth-signal command the reviewer MUST run. Planner defines this per task (validation lapis-1). Last task also carries the level-DAG integration check.
tasks._acceptanceResult_doc: null initially. Result of running checkCommand. Review pass REQUIRES acceptanceResult=pass, i.e. green executable, NOT just reading code.

assumptions.context: what was ambiguous (spec gap / two valid designs)
assumptions._durable_doc: true -> also push to knowledgeDelta[] -> .pi/rules (durable convention). false -> stays here (judgment audit only).
